photo.alt: The Canary Islands from orbit, off the northwest coast of Africa
photo.credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center from Greenbelt, MD, USA, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: About 2.26 million people (2025) on about 7,446 km²
Seven main islands, the largest being Tenerife
worth_knowing: A Spanish autonomous community about 100 km off the northwest coast of Africa. Mount Teide on Tenerife is the highest peak in Spain.
